info.title: Yoink native API
info.description: Registered native HTTP contracts. Product routes require their installed service; unavailable services return 503. Bearer claims identify actors only; current native roles, bans, grants and ownership authorize each operation. No public OpenAPI or download-executor control alias is registered.

post.description: Owner-only, using fresh native authority. Jobs are actor-isolated, bounded, restart-ephemeral and evicted; missing or evicted jobs return 404. Imports are atomic additive transactions and preserve live rows.

Owner-only, using fresh native authority. Jobs are actor-isolated, bounded, restart-ephemeral and evicted; missing or evicted jobs return 404. Imports are atomic additive transactions and preserve live rows. Path reads are confined to the configured private root, reject traversal/symlinks/nonregular files, and never delete inputs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required when is_local is false. Reuse the same key and unchanged request for the original remote operation; changing the request with that key conflicts instead of starting another remote operation. Local creation does not require this header.
